Add Objective-C EMAPI SDK implementation

Add Objective-C EMAPI SDK implementation

Details:
- Add EMAPI constants, command model, CRC32, frame codec/parser, TLV, payload, chunk helpers, models, session, connection adapter, and printer facade.
- Implement ACK-gated request/response handling, retries, pending batched frame retention, protocol/passthrough errors, report ACK handling, and flow-control busy gating.
- Expose system, RFID, WiFi passthrough/file, printer, ESC transfer, OTA/file transfer, and upgrade APIs matching the Dart EMAPI facade semantics.
- Add an EMAPI Xcode framework project, shared scheme, workspace entry, and XCTest coverage for golden frames, TLV/chunk helpers, session retention, reports, ACK-gated printing, WiFi, and OTA/file transfer payloads.
